senses.gloss:
उदि उद्-इ, cl. 2. P. -एति, -एतुम्, to go up or
proceed; to rise (e. g. as a star), to come up (as a
cloud); to go out of; to come out or arise from; to
escape; to start up; to rise up against.

उदित 2. उदित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वद्), said,
spoken.
—उदितोदित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 2. उदित with
1. उद्-इत), well-grounded in the Śāstras.

उदित 3. उदित, अस्, आ, अम् (incorrectly spelt
for उद्-दित, see 4. दा), bound, tied.
उद्-दित, अस्, आ, अम्, bound, tied.

1. उद्-इति, इस्, f., Ved. ascending, rising (of the
sun); going away or down, setting (of the sun).
2. उदिति, इस्, f., Ved. speech.
उद्-ईयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, rising.

उदिङ्ग् उद्-इङ्ग्, Caus. P. -इङ्गयति, -यितुम्,
to impart a tremulous motion, to vibrate; to utter
with a whirring or vibratory sound; to cause to whir
(said of the pronunciation of certain letters).

उदिनक्ष् उद्-इनक्ष् (irreg. Desid. of rt.
नक्ष्), Ved. -इनक्षति, to attain, obtain, reach; to
wish to gain, to pretend to.

उदीक्ष् उद्-ईक्ष्, cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -षितुम्,
to look up to; to look at, regard, view, behold; to
wait, to delay, to expect: Caus. -ईक्षयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to look up.
उद्-ईक्षण, अम्, n. looking up, seeing, beholding.
उद्-ईक्ष्य, ind. having looked up at, having seen.

उदीचीन उदीचीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 2. उद्-अञ्च्),
turned towards the north, northern.

उदीच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being or living in the north;
(अस्), m. the country to the north and west of the
river Sarasvatī, the northern region; (आस्), m. the
inhabitants of this country; (अम्), n. a kind of per-
fume.
—उदीच्य-वृत्त, अम्, n. the metre of the
inhabitants of the northern country, a species of the
Vaitālīya metre.

उदीप उद्-ईप, अस्, m. (fr. 1. उद् and अप्, water),
high water, an inundation; (अस्, आ, अम्), flooded.

उदीर् उद्-ईर्, cl. 2. A. -ईर्ते, -ईरितुम्, to rise;
to start (in order to go or to come); to move up-
wards, ascend; to arise, originate: Caus. -ईरयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to rise or move; to throw or cast
upwards, to cast, throw, discharge, to drive forward;
to rouse up, excite; to raise one's voice; to utter,
speak; to effect; to make visible: Pass. -ईर्यते, to be
cast or thrown upwards; to be excited; to be uttered,
announced, enunciated; to sound; to issue forth.

उद्-ईरण, अं, n. throwing, casting, discharging
(a missile); speaking, saying.

उद्-ईरित, अस्, आ, अम्, said, uttered; excited, ani-
[]
mated.
—उदीरित-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, whose mind is active,
acute-minded.

उद्-ईर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, issued out, excited, increased,
intense; generous, great, excellent.
—उदीर्ण-ता, f.
excitement, activity, agility.
—उदीर्ण-दीधिति, इस्,
इस्, इ, intensely bright.
—उदीर्ण-वेग, अस्, आ, अम्,
impetuous in its course (as a torrent), violent.
1. उद्-ईर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be raised, uttered, spoken.
2. उद्-ईर्य, ind. having uttered, having spoken.

उद्-ईर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being cast or discharged;
being spoken or uttered.

उदीष् उद्-ईष्, cl. 1. A. -ईषते, -ईषितुम्, to
rise.

उद्दिश् 1. उद्-दिश्, cl. 6. P. A., 3. P. -दिशति,
-ते, -दिदेष्टि, -देष्टुम्, to show or direct towards;
to point out, signify, declare, determine; to enunciate,
prophesy; to mean; to aim at, intend, destine; to
explain, instruct, teach.

2. उद्-दिश्, क्, f., Ved. a particular direction or quarter
of the sky.
उद्-ईषित, अस्, आ, अम्, risen, elevated.

उद्दिधीर्षा उद्-दिधीर्षा. See under 1. उद्-
धृ.
उद्-दिधीर्षा, f. wish to remove.
उद्दिन उद्-दिन, अम्, n. midday.

उद्-दिश्य, ind. having shown or explained; stipu-
lating for, demanding; aiming at, in the direction of,
with reference to; towards; with regard to, for, for
the sake of, in the name of.

उद्-दिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, mentioned, particularized,
described, promised.

उद्दिह् उद्-दिह्, cl. 2. P. A., Ved. -देग्धि,
-दिग्धे, -देग्धुम्, to throw or heap up.

उद्दीप् उद्-दीप्, cl. 4. A. -दीप्यते, -दीपितुम्,
to flame, blaze up, be kindled: Caus. -दीपयति,
-यितुम्, to light up, inflame, illuminate, excite, ani-
mate.

उद्-दीपक, अस्, आ, अम्, inflaming, exciting, ren-
dering more intense; lighting, setting alight.
उद्-दीपक; add — (अस्), m. a kind of bird.

उद्-दीपन, अम्, n. inflaming (as passion), exciting,
animating; illuminating; burning of a body &c.;
any aggravating thing or circumstance, giving poig-
nancy to feeling or passion.

उद्-दीपमान, अस्, आ, अम्, lighting up, brighten-
ing, becoming light.

उद्-दीप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted, set on fire or alight;
shining; inflamed, aggravated (as passion).
उद्-दीप्र, अम्, n. bdellium.
